# SD Police

## 1. Installation
spooni_sd_police works Standalone.  

To install spooni_sd_police:
- Drag and drop the resource into your resources folder
  - `spooni_sd_police`
- Add this ensure in your server.cfg
  - `ensure spooni_sd_police`
- At the end
  - Restart the server

---------------------------------------------------------
----> Update for SD Police + SD Fight Club <----
If you have the SD Fight Club
copy the File from the "Update" Folder 
to the "stream" Folder from 
"spooni_sd_fight_club/stream" 
and 
to the stream Folder from 
"spooni_sd_police/stream" 
and 
replace it.

After this delete the "Update" Folders. 
Restart Server 
finish.
---------------------

---------------------------------------------------------
----> Update for SD Police + SD Theater <----
If you have the SD Theater
copy the File from the "Update" Folder 
to the "stream" Folder from 
"spooni_sd_theater/stream" 
and 
to the stream Folder from 
"spooni_sd_police/stream" 
and 
replace it.

After this delete the "Update" Folders. 
Restart Server 
finish.
---------------------

If you have any problems, you can always open a ticket in the 
[Spooni Discord] https://discord.gg/spooni
